STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_DRIED_INSPIRATION.title: Dried Inspiration
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_DRIED_INSPIRATION.descr: At the start of your turn, if you have no [gold]Concept[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold], add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Concept[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_DRIED_INSPIRATION.flavo: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_OVERFLOWING_INSPIRATION: At the start of your turn, if you have no [gold]Concept[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold], add [blue]1[/blue] [green]Concept+[/green] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_UNFINISHED_CHIPS.title: Unfinished Chips
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_UNFINISHED_CHIPS.descri: For every [blue]50[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] you have, raise your Max HP by [blue]1[/blue] whenever you enter a [gold]Shop[/gold] or a [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_WINNING_SCRIPT.title: Winning Script
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_WINNING_SCRIPT.descript: Whenever you play a [gold]Concept[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_OLD_GAME_CONSOLE.title: Well-Kept Old Console
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_OLD_GAME_CONSOLE.descri: At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Minigame[/gold] card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_GREEN_CHARM.title: Green Charm
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_GREEN_CHARM.description: At the start of your turn, you may [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a [red]Curse[/red] to increase your [gold]Concept[/gold] number by [blue]1[/blue].
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_BOARD_GAME_OF_LIFE.desc: Whenever you play a [gold]Minigame[/gold] card, add a random card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_G_BIBLE.title: G.Bible
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_G_BIBLE.description: Every [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Minigame[/gold] cards you play, heal [green]6[/green] HP.
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_MIRROR.title: "Mirror"
STS2_MOMOI_RELIC_MIRROR.description: At the end of your first turn, you may choose a card to copy and [gold]Retain[/gold] them for one turn.
